target_customer: Online travel agencies and travel companies that want to sell airport transfers and ground transportation
problem: Travel companies lack an easy way to sell airport transportation online with reliable supply and margin.
business_model: B2B API and marketplace with a take on each transfer sold (company claims up to 20 percent profit uplift per transaction)

founders.name: Barsi Luna
previous_startups: Previously created travel companies (unnamed on the YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page: 13+ years of travel industry experience, operations focus.

founders.name: Jorge De Cordova
education: Began a college degree in advertising and communications (completion not stated)
founders.background_notes: Started in tourism to pay college fees and met Luna at his first job; YC page says he is 32 and Mexican (current age on the page, not at founding).

founders.name: Luis Uicab
founders.background_notes: No bio on the YC page.

competitors.name: Mozio
competitors.what: Airport and ground transportation aggregator with an API, white label and widget
competitors.traction_then: API covers about 100 ground providers worldwide (undated vendor description)
competitors.funding_then: 750K raise reported by Skift in 2014; later funding not checked

competitors.name: Suntransfers
competitors.what: Transfers provider offering API integrations for OTAs and B2B partners

technical_complexity.rationale: API aggregation of transfer suppliers and checkout integration; operations and supplier network matter more than technology.

defensibility.rationale: Supplier relationships in Cancun and integrations into OTA checkouts create some lock in, but Mozio and others offer similar APIs.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found; CB Insights lists Shuttle Central among Mozio's and Transferz's competitors.

market_need_then: Travel rebound after the pandemic and OTAs wanting ancillary revenue; Cancun is a high volume airport transfer market.

branding.domain_note: Uses shuttlecentral.com per YesPress; booking site at book.shuttlecentral.com.
branding.community_and_virality: Won MassChallenge Mexico 2021 acceleration program, covered by Travel2Latam; no consumer brand community found.

brand_strength.rationale: A descriptive and generic name in a B2B niche; there are other firms called Shuttle Planet and Shuttle Direct, and no press on the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Shuttle Central started in Cancun in 2019, won MassChallenge Mexico in 2021 and joined YC in Winter 2022. Aggregator profiles claim about 4.4 million dollars in ARR and customers such as Expedia Group and Booking Holdings, but these are unverified. Its team grew to 28, which suggests operating traction, but funding and revenue claims are not confirmed.
notes: Book site returned HTTP 522 when fetched, so the company website was not read. Unverified aggregator figures: 1.79M total (CB Insights), 5.59M total across 3 rounds (another profile), about 4.4M ARR, 500K on 2022-03-29. The MassChallenge investment from Angel Ventures is reported as 100,000K, ambiguous, so the amount is left null. Competitor Mozio source is a 2014 funding story, much older than the batch; Suntransfers source is undated. Luna's description as a Smart Tourism Mexico co-founder comes from a search summary and is not recorded.
